nphi.title: Andean Health and Climate Change Plan 2026–2031
nphi.with: Health ministries of the six Andean countries; PAHO/WHO
nphi.summary: A subregional plan, approved in Lima in June 2026 and presented at the PAHO Directing Council, to help Andean health systems anticipate and respond to climate-related health risks through sector leadership, surveillance and evidence, and…

nphi.title: CDC South America Regional Office (SAMRO)
nphi.with: Brazil Ministry of Health – Secretariat of Health and Environmental Surveillance (General Coordination of Public Health Laboratories); Pará State Health Secretariat; Ecuador FETP
nphi.summary: Established in 2020 in Brasília, SAMRO supports surveillance modernisation, lab quality (SLIPTA/SLMTA with Brazil's lab network), FETP (Ecuador) and outbreak response (dengue, Oropouche, avian influenza) across South America.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: InDRE mission to strengthen quality and biorisk management at Bolivia's reference laboratories
nphi.actor: Instituto de Diagnóstico y Referencia Epidemiológicos (InDRE)
nphi.with: INLASA (La Paz); CENETROP (Santa Cruz); PAHO; WHO collaborating centres
nphi.summary: Experts from Mexico's InDRE, with PAHO and WHO collaborating centres, assessed and trained Bolivia's INLASA and CENETROP on biosafety and quality management for influenza and emerging pathogens.

nphi.title: Andean genomic surveillance exchange for El Niño-related infectious diseases (ORAS-CONHU)
nphi.with: ORAS-CONHU (Andean Health Organization); IDB; national health institutes of Bolivia, Colombia and Ecuador
nphi.summary: Under an Andean Health Organization project with the IDB, Peru's INS agreed to share diagnostic and genomic-characterisation know-how with Bolivia and Ecuador ahead of El Niño, and the four national institutes planned a regional…

nphi.title: 2022 IANPHI Latin America Annual Meeting – Declaration of Cuernavaca on Health Equity
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: NPHIs of Bolivia, Brazil (Fiocruz), Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Peru, Suriname; PAHO subregional programmes; ACTO; ORAS-CONHU; SICA/COMISCA
nphi.summary: Latin American NPHIs adopted a declaration on health equity, inequity monitoring, food insecurity, environmental crisis impacts and integrated surveillance.

nphi.title: IANPHI Latin America Network COVID-19 exchanges
nphi.with: ANLIS (Argentina); INLASA (Bolivia); CARPHA; INS Colombia; INCIENSA (Costa Rica); INSP Mexico; INS Peru; Guyana CMO; Uruguay MoH
nphi.summary: The Fiocruz-chaired Latin American NPHI network held bi-weekly virtual meetings in 2020 to share COVID-19 responses, serology, lab quality control and kit production.

nphi.summary: INLASA visited INS Peru in April 2014 to start a cooperation on lab diagnosis, surveillance and research. INS was also to give technical help with INLASA's system assessment and strategic plan. Both sides planned a long-term twinning,…
